ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב פָּחַד מֵהַמַּעֲבָר לְמִצְרַיִם, וְקִבֵּל דִּבְרֵי עִדּוּד.
ideas.children_en: Jacob left Hebron and went to Beer Sheba to offer sacrifices to his father. At night God spoke to him in a dream, told him not to be afraid to go to Egypt, and that he will become a great nation there. God promised to help him on his way.

ideas.children_he: כָּל הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה יָצְאָה יַחַד לְמַסָּע הֶחָדָשׁ.
ideas.children_en: After God allowed him to go, Jacob's sons carried him and his family on carts. They took all their flocks and property. So Jacob and all his family reached Egypt.

ideas.children_he: שְׁמוֹת הַיְּלָדִים וְהַנְּכָדִים מַזְכִּירִים שֶׁכָּל אָדָם הוּא חֵלֶק מֵהַמִּשְׁפָּחָה.
ideas.children_en: The list gives the names of Jacob's sons by Leah, plus his daughter Dinah. They led different families in Israel and had children of their own.

ideas.children_he: גַּם הַמִּשְׁפָּחוֹת שֶׁל גָּד וְאָשֵׁר הָיוּ חֵלֶק מִבֵּית יַעֲקֹב.
ideas.children_en: The sons of Gad, Asher, and Zilpah (Leah's maid) are named. His granddaughter Serach was special and blessed. These groups were part of Jacob's family.

ideas.children_he: מִשְׁפַּחְתָּם שֶׁל רָחֵל וּבָנֶיהָ הִמְשִׁיכָה לִגְדֹּל.
ideas.children_en: Rachel had Joseph and Benjamin by Jacob. Joseph was born in Egypt and had two sons. Benjamin's sons are listed too. Rachel’s family counted fourteen people.

ideas.children_he: הַתּוֹרָה מַזְכִּירָה גַּם אֶת מִשְׁפְּחוֹת דָּן וְנַפְתָּלִי.
ideas.children_en: Dan and his descendants are mentioned. Dan had one son, Hushim, with many descendants. Naphtali and Bilhah’s sons (Rachel’s maid) are listed. These families were part of Jacob’s family.

ideas.children_he: מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ שֶׁל יַעֲקֹב גָּדְלָה לְקְבוּצָה גְּדוֹלָה.
ideas.children_en: All Jacob’s descendants who came to Egypt numbered sixty-six, without the wives. Adding Jacob, Joseph, and his two sons, the total was seventy people.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב וְיוֹסֵף נִפְגְּשׁוּ שׁוּב וּבָכוּ מֵרֹב הִתְרַגְּשׁוּת.
ideas.children_en: Jacob sent Judah to tell Joseph and guide his family to Goshen. Joseph met his father, hugged and cried. Jacob said he could die peacefully because he saw Joseph alive.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף רָצָה לְהַצִּיג אֶת מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ בִּפְנֵי פַּרְעֹה.
ideas.children_en: Joseph told his family to go to the capital city and tell Pharaoh that they came from Canaan to him.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף סִפֵּר בְּגַאֲוָה עַל עֲבוֹדַת הָאַחִים כְּרוֹעֵי צֹאן.
ideas.children_en: Joseph explained his brothers are shepherds and they brought sheep, cattle, and other possessions with them.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף עָזַר לְאֶחָיו לְהִתְכּוֹנֵן לַשִּׂיחָה עִם פַּרְעֹה.
ideas.children_en: Joseph prepared his brothers to say to Pharaoh that they raised cattle all their lives. This would help them live in Goshen.
